p.c: function[T0, T1](x0: T0 -> T1, x1: FiniteSet[T1], x2: T0) { rv_in_event_contains[T0, T1](x0, x1, x2) = x0(x2) ∈ x1 }[T, A](rv, event, x)

goal: finite_set_filter[T](pmf.support, rv_in_event_contains[T, A](rv, event)).contains(x) = (pmf.support.contains(x) and rv_in_event_contains[T, A](rv, event, x))
finite_set_filter[T](pmf.support, rv_in_event_contains[T, A](rv, event)).contains(x) = (pmf.support.contains(x) and event.contains(rv(x)))
rv_in_event[T, A](pmf, rv, event) = finite_set_filter[T](pmf.support, rv_in_event_contains[T, A](rv, event))

p.c: function[T0, T1](x0: DiscretePMF[T0], x1: T0 -> T1, x2: FiniteSet[T1]) { finite_set_filter[T0](x0.support, rv_in_event_contains[T0, T1](x1, x2)) = rv_in_event[T0, T1](x0, x1, x2) }[T, A](pmf, rv, event)

goal: rv_in_event[T, A](pmf, rv, event).contains(x) = (pmf.support.contains(x) and event.contains(rv(x)))
rv_in_event_indicator[T, A](pmf, rv, event, x) = finite_event_indicator(rv_in_event[T, A](pmf, rv, event), x)

p.c: function[T0, T1](x0: DiscretePMF[T0], x1: T0 -> T1, x2: FiniteSet[T1], x3: T0) { finite_event_indicator[T0](rv_in_event[T0, T1](x0, x1, x2), x3) = rv_in_event_indicator[T0, T1](x0, x1, x2, x3) }[T, A](pmf, rv, event, x)

goal: rv_in_event_indicator[T, A](pmf, rv, event) = finite_event_indicator[T](rv_in_event[T, A](pmf, rv, event))
discrete_expectation[T](pmf, rv_in_event_indicator[T, A](pmf, rv, event)) = discrete_expectation[T](pmf, finite_event_indicator[T](rv_in_event[T, A](pmf, rv, event)))
discrete_expectation[T](pmf, finite_event_indicator[T](rv_in_event[T, A](pmf, rv, event))) = pmf_event_prob[T](pmf, rv_in_event[T, A](pmf, rv, event))
discrete_expectation[T](pmf, rv_in_event_indicator[T, A](pmf, rv, event)) = pmf_event_prob[T](pmf, rv_in_event[T, A](pmf, rv, event))
